questions.prompt: What does a conditional type do?
options: It runs only after JavaScript has started.
It selects a type result based on an assignability relationship between types.
It chooses a runtime branch after reading user input.
questions.answer_key: It selects a type result based on an assignability relationship between types.
questions.explanation: Conditional types operate in TypeScript’s type system, not as emitted runtime conditionals.
